name: Roblox

changelog: Regular update with bug fixes and improvements for speed and reliability.

summary: Roblox is a free online platform from Roblox Corporation where you play millions of games, called experiences, made by other players, and can build your own. The official Roblox APK on Google Play was last updated on October 28, 2026, and needs Android 8.0 or newer. It's free, with optional Robux purchases.
metaDescription: Get the official Roblox APK for Android 8.0+. Play millions of free experiences: install steps, parental controls, Robux scams to avoid and safety FAQ.

faq.q: How do I install Roblox on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Roblox and check the developer is Roblox Corporation before tapping Install. It needs Android 8.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Roblox Corporation and may be altered, so the safest way to play Roblox is the official listing.

faq.q: Is Roblox free to play on Android?
faq.a: Yes. Roblox is free to download and almost every experience on it is free to play. Money comes in through Robux, the in-game currency, which players spend on avatar items and upgrades inside experiences. Google Play lists Robux purchases from $0.50 to $199.99, and Roblox Premium is an optional subscription.

Roblox can be safe for children with the right settings. Parents can link their own account to manage chat, spending limits and which experiences their child can join, based on content maturity labels. Google Play rates the app Teen, and because players talk to strangers, setting up parental controls is worth the ten minutes.

faq.q: Why does Roblox show "Varies with device" as the version?
faq.a: Roblox ships slightly different builds to different phones, so Google Play shows "Varies with device" instead of a single version number. Updates arrive often, roughly every week, and Play installs the right build for your phone automatically. That's why we list the update date rather than a version number.

Not from generators or apps that promise it. Sites and APKs offering free Robux are scams that steal accounts or install malware. Legitimate ways to get Robux are buying them, Roblox Premium, gift cards, and selling items or game passes you create, through Roblox's own systems.

faq.q: What Android version do I need for Roblox?
faq.a: Roblox needs Android 8.0 or newer, according to its Google Play listing. It also needs a constant internet connection, since every experience runs online. Bigger experiences can be demanding, so lowering the graphics level in Roblox's settings helps on older phones.
